articles.title: FBI seizes $1.2bn stolen in Binance cryptocurrency hack
articles.summary: The FBI has seized more than $1.2bn (£910m) of cryptocurrency stolen from Binance last month.

articles.title: Sharp rise in deadly antibiotic-resistant infections
articles.summary: Hundreds of people are being diagnosed with potentially life-threatening antibiotic-resistant infections each week, new figures suggest.

articles.title: Body mass index may have misclassified millions of people in UK, researchers say
articles.summary: Millions of people may have been misclassified on the body mass index (BMI) scale, research has suggested.

articles.title: Anthropic seeks $1.4trn valuation amid worry over AI investment
articles.summary: AI chatbot maker Anthropic is seeking a stock market valuation of up to $1.4trn (£1trn).

articles.title: Storms hitting UK at same time led to one of country's wettest days on record
articles.summary: Storms Austen and Boelo striking different parts of the UK at the same time contributed to 24 October being one of the wettest days Britain has ever seen.

articles.title: FBI investigating Nvidia CEO over affair with alleged Chinese spy
articles.summary: Donald Trump has said the FBI is looking into Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy - but insisted he is a "very honourable man".

articles.title: FDA orders blindness risk warning on weight loss drugs
articles.summary: Companies making popular weight loss drugs, including Ozempic and Wegovy, will be required to add a warning label about a rare eye condition that can cause blindness, the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has said.
